newsitem.title: UK: All three Brent cargoes kept - traders.
newsitem.headline: All three Brent cargoes kept - traders.

text.p: All three Brent cargoes due to turn wet on Friday were kept well ahead of the five o'clock deadline by their equity holders, traders said.
Exxon kept an Aug 18-20 cargo, Shell UK kept an Aug 17-19 cargo and Texaco kept at Aug 18-20 cargo, they said.
Brent cargoes are traded on a paper, or forward market until the 1700 London time deadline on the nearest trading day 15 days before their assigned loading date.
